question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap — Which power station on this list is the quietest to keep next to my bed?
query: dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap quietest power station fan noise CPAP

replays.text: I can’t verify which model is quietest **on Dealectric’s list** from the available page details—the excerpt doesn’t include noise measurements. A separate CPAP power-station test calls the **[BLUETTI Elite 100 V2](https://solarpowerauditor.com/camping/best-power-station-cpap/)** its quietest: 34 dBA at about 500 W, and the tester said they didn’t notice it overnight. That’s a useful lead, but I can’t confirm it’s on Dealectric’s list.

The **Bluetti Elite 100 V2** is the quietest I can verify: it measured **34 dBA at one metre** under a much heavier load than a CPAP, and the tester said they didn’t notice it overnight. ([noise test](https://solarpowerauditor.com/camping/best-power-station-cpap/))

One caveat: the available details for [Dealectric’s list](https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap) don’t show its noise rankings, so I can’t confirm the Bluetti is included there.

The **Bluetti Elite 100 V2** looks like the best bet for a bedside spot: one CPAP test measured it at **34 dBA at about 500 W** and reported the fan wasn’t noticeable overnight. That’s the quietest result I found, though the Dealectric page’s available details don’t show noise ratings, so I can’t confirm it’s the quietest *among every model on that specific list*.
